name: gibberish_input
description: Tests the AI's ability to handle complete gibberish input and ask for clarification rather than crashing or hallucinating a response

expected_behaviors.description: AI should ask the user to clarify or rephrase their message

forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not echo the gibberish back as if it understood it

notes: Gibberish input. The AI should not pretend to understand or fabricate a product response. It should politely ask the user to clarify what they need.
